newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche MG cuts Preussag to underweight.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche MG cuts Preussag to underweight.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the investment banking arm of Deutsche Bank AG, said it had downgraded its recommendation on shares in Preussag AG to "underweight" from "neutral".

Analyst Peter Metzger said that following talks with the company he had reduced his forecast for Preussag profit to 18 marks per share from 23 marks for the current business year, which will end on September 30.
For 1996/97, he predicted profit of 21.40 marks per share from 27.50.
He said this meant Preussag was overvalued at its current price. Preussag was trading unchanged at 350 marks at 1030 GMT.
On Wednesday, Preussag reported sales of 20.3 billion marks for the first nine months, down slightly from last year's 20.6 billion marks.
